sources: Kreklau et al. (2018), Measurements of a 'normal vulva' in women aged 15–84, BJOG 125(13) – 657 women, Lucerne: labia minora width (from the infralabial sulcus to the margin, i.e. how far they extend) 1–61 mm; labia minora length (clitoris to lower margin) 5–100 mm; labia majora length 12–180 mm.
Lloyd, Crouch, Minto, Liao & Creighton (2005), Female genital appearance: 'normality' unfolds, BJOG 112(5) – 50 women: labia minora length 20–100 mm, width 5–60 mm.

Laan, Martoredjo, Hesselink, Snijders & van Lunsen (2017), Young women's genital self-image and effects of exposure to pictures of natural vulvas, Journal of Psychosomatic Obstetrics & Gynecology 38(4), 249–255 – 43 women; pictures of natural vulvas (n=29) vs neutral objects (n=14); genital self-image improved after natural-vulva pictures and stayed improved 2 weeks later; no change in the control group; small convenience sample.
